notes.title: Bugfix 2.0
notes.notes:
Russ, we continue to fix the game, make it tastier and better.

List of changes and fixed bugs:


 Now the hits of all the characters are generally COOL and VERY CLEAR, the collision tracking system has been completely reworked.
 Fixed the bug with the quest in the hub after the Dinosaur Plains level
 Fixed lizard spawn in the Hub on the training field
 Fixed the achievements of "Three Little Pigs" and "Bear Bear"
 Fixed the visual of the level selection window
 Fixed lizards falling into the moat and underground in Wave mode
 Added nicknames of players in multiplayer to the portraits of heroes
 Fixed a bug with getting stuck on a cannon in the Dinosaur Pasture level
 Fixed timings of the halberd lizard attack




TAB!!!! Guys, the game has target capture and switching, it's on the TAB key, added to the control settings

notes.title: Bugfix 1.0
notes.notes:
Brothers, we have came upwith the first hotfix and we continue to work on issues:
 
Lizards falling underground bug fixes
Now they fall less often, and if they fall, they die.
At the Baikal level, they should stop falling underground altogether, checked on several devices.


Red screen on laptops with integrated or missing graphics cards
Go to settings, click video settings, click FIX RED SCREEN
Who doesn't have this problem, DON'T CLICK


Game crashes almost immediately after launch

If the graphics card is from NVIDIA, then you need to check if FSR is enabled in the settings, if the card is from AMD, then you need to turn off DLSS.
It can also help to run the game in windowed mode, if the point above does not help.



Connecting to an online game

 Added regions. Now it is better to choose a region by location (Europe, Asia, America, China).
 Unfortunately, our network engine is not native, NOT OURS, so it's the hardest to fight with it. If you can't connect for more than a minute, you can try closing the game and run it again, which usually helps.
 If the above methods do not help, you can go to the multiplayer-europe branch, the guide is in discussion panel on Steam.
 Some Internet service providers may still have problems logging out of the coop mode.



Other changes and improvements:

 At the Baikal level, you can now ride in Hardcore cart mode
 Dynamite no longer causes damage toheroes 
 The tank's health has been slightly reduced
 The brightness slider is now working
 Fixed a bug with the choice of characters after the cutscene with pyaterochka
 Fixed a bug with Mstislav's scarecrow (it no longer remains in the hand when dying and taking damage).


 
If any other bugs occurs, write us, we will be in touch!
